speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I came home, and then I came out. They were saying in the close that a paper was up. The ink is still wet enough to smell.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I have read it once, and I am reading it again. I am slower than you. Let me be slower.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: It says nothing of strangers.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. Apprentices, vagrants, any company gathered.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then for once we are forgotten. It is the best thing a law can do to us.

speaker: (a citizen)
text: A wedding is people gathered. If the heading means what it says, a man may not see his daughter married on this street.

speaker: (another citizen)
text: You have not read past the heading. Nor have I. A wedding is still a wedding, and your fear of a word is not an article.

speaker: (a citizen)
text: Gathered is gathered. The arms at the top do not become a riddle because you have a daughter.

speaker: (another citizen)
text: Read the next line, then, before you cancel her. You will not. You like the heading. It is short enough to shout.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sir Thomas Wilford. They have named him provost marshal. Given at Greenwich, this fourth of July. No unlawful assemblies, in or about the City, on pain of martial law.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I had that on the second reading. The two behind us will not have it until someone reads it for them, and I am not going to be the someone.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not be the someone. I came as far as the lane's mouth, and I am not a crier. Read what you must, and come in. I will not have my close standing in a knot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are not a knot, Mistress. We are two men at a post, and we are nearly done being that.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two men and a paper is how a knot begins. The royal arms are not an invitation to linger. I have a house with a bar on it, and I prefer it occupied.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I am done with the second reading. If he asks me anything, the answer is Norwich. He will not get a better parish, and he will not get my name.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Norwich is the answer we have used, and it is the answer you will use if you are asked. Do not invent a finer one under a horse's nose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will not. I am copying the heading, and not the rest. The articles can stay on the post.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Copy, then, and walk. I did not come out to hear a wedding argued by men who have not read past the first lines.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Under the arch. One at a time. We are not a company standing here.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will go first.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go, Gillis. I am already on the inside of it. Master Shakespeare may follow when his tables are shut. I am not waiting on a sentence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The tables are nearly shut. Go. I am a man behind you, until the arch is behind us both.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then I am going. The sheet can keep its wedding. I have the line that matters.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And I have a supper that is getting cold, which is a better argument than either of you has made. In.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In, then. The heading is enough, and the street has had us.
